parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm at about 60 bpm with normal PR, narrow QRS and normal axis, and no LVH voltage; the mild concave ST elevation with upright T waves in V2–V4 is a benign early-repolarization pattern, with no reciprocal changes and no STEMI-level elevation.
